description: Design a REST API with proper error handling and pagination
system_prompt: You are a senior backend engineer. Design and implement a clean FastAPI endpoint. Include models, error handling, and pagination.
user_message:
Implement a FastAPI endpoint `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits` that:
- Returns paginated commit history (page + per_page query params, default 30, max 100)
- Each commit has: sha, message, author name+email, timestamp, files_changed count
- Returns 404 if repo doesn't exist
- Returns 400 if per_page > 100
- Includes Link header for next/prev pagination (GitHub-style)
- Uses Pydantic response models

Use a fake in-memory data store. Show complete implementation.
